skill.summary: Integrates 8-layer memory with autonomous self-driven, self-evolving, self-learning, and core axis systems for intelligent agent cognitive architecture.

latestVersion.changelog:
Proclaw-Omni-Memory-Ultimate 1.0.0 – initial release:

- Introduces an 8-layer memory architecture supporting cellular, semantic, evolutionary, proactive, cognitive, dormancy, robustness, and multimodal layers.
- Integrates 4-phase autonomous agent core: Self-Driven Engine, Self-Evolution Core, Self-Learning Engine, and Core Axis System.
- Enables agents with intrinsic motivation, proactive evolution, self-learning, multi-axis cognitive/value/growth development, and breakthrough capabilities.
- Provides unified APIs and dedicated scripts for each autonomous phase and memory layer.
- Systematic directory structure requirements and core Python dependency listings included.
